ModMetaData.name: Security and Blast Doors Expanded
ModMetaData.author: LadySylveon
ModMetaData.description: Rejoice, blast doors are here! This mod adds more sizes, new materials, integrated vac barriers, and more to security doors making these once overlooked doors into top-tier infrastructure for your colony and gravship. No longer underpowered, one trick ponies that can't even keep a revenant at bay. And yes, this mod does keep revenants and other nuisance entities locked out (or in) as well.
